Exam prep is evergreen: every year a new cohort of students needs the same score to emigrate or study abroad. One narrow job (grade an IELTS essay), SEO-driven, and a near-zero cost base. Monthly revenue has sat at 5 dollars–6k for a full year.

You paste an essay. A couple of minutes later you get a report on the weak spots, aimed at the score people need for a visa or a place at a university. You can pay for a week, a month, or a year. The company dates to 2018. The founder’s user count sits far above the paying subscriptions. The margin on the snapshot is very high, which fits a checker with almost no staff cost.
